title: MA61024: Computational Geometry
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: voidIntroduction, historical prospective, geometry preliminaries,
convex hull algorithm in two and three dimensions, lower bounds, triangulation,
Voronoi diagram, closest pair problems, duality in Voronoi diagrams, geometric
searching, visibility, art gallery problem, arrangement of lines, sweep
techniques, fortune sweep for voronoi diagrams, topological sweep for line
arrangement, combinatorial geometry, intersection and union of rectangles,
robust geometric computing, applications of computational geometry.
